descrizione: Testi delle schede in italiano e inglese. «esatte»: frasi fisse; «modelli»: frasi con numeri o nomi, con segnaposto {nK} = numero (si converte nel formato inglese), {sK} = testo copiato come sta, {tK} = testo tradotto a sua volta. L'inglese si ricava dall'italiano dello script: se una frase italiana cambia, va cambiata anche qui (lo script avvisa delle frasi senza traduzione).

esatte.Rapporto mediano fra tempo coi mezzi e t: Median ratio of public transport time to car time, weighted by morning cars, at 4 times of day. Two lines: estimate with TomTom's slowdown (scaled to the other hours) and estimate with the sensors' slowdown.

esatte.Verso Piazza Castello alle 8. Barra scur: To Piazza Castello at 8. Dark bar = TomTom estimate, light bar = estimate most favourable to the car (5T sensors). Fewer minutes = more promising point; 0 = the bus is already faster.

esatte.Rapporto 2 = coi mezzi pubblici si impie: Ratio 2 = public transport takes twice as long as the car. Turin-Turin and Turin-belt pairs. Main estimate: car time forecast by TomTom; next to it the estimate most favourable to the car (5T sensors).

esatte.Tipo di dato: misurato, con la posizione: Type of data: measured, with the GPS position of the vehicles.

esatte.Tipo di dato: calcolato da dati veri, co: Type of data: calculated from real data, with car times from TomTom, sensor measurements and the official timetables of the vehicles.
esatte.Il traffico è un modello e sostituisce r: Traffic comes from a model and stands in for noise and smog, which are not measured.
esatte.GPS e dato ufficiale GTT: passaggi con o: GPS and official GTT figure: arrivals more than 10 minutes late
esatte.Il GPS è la media della settimana, in qu: GPS is the weekly average, counted in four ways. GTT is the year 2025, all lines, with an unpublished method.
esatte.su 100 a tarda sera (19-24): out of 100 in the late evening (19-24)
esatte.Si conta quanto spesso c'è ritardo, non: The figure counts how often there is a delay, not how many people are waiting.
esatte.Quanto si aspetta in più di quanto dice: How much longer the wait is than the timetable says
esatte.Ogni barra è una fascia del giorno feria: Each bar is a part of the weekday: the extra minutes of waiting compared with the timetable. On the right, the real wait against the promised one.
esatte.Il grafico mostra la media della settima: The chart shows the weekly average (weekday 5 : Saturday 1 : Sunday 1).
esatte.La gara: bus e auto verso Piazza Castell: The race: bus and car to Piazza Castello, at 8 a.m. on a weekday
esatte.Bus e auto partono insieme da ogni parch: Bus and car leave together from each car park, one after the other. The car has the time forecast by TomTom, parking included.
esatte.Barra = minuti coi mezzi pubblici fino a: Bar = minutes by public transport to Piazza Castello at 8 a.m. On the right, the car time with parking included (TomTom), and how full the car park is during the day.
esatte.Tempi in auto previsti da TomTom su traf: Car times forecast by TomTom for typical traffic on a November weekday, not measured on a specific day. A single service is used.
